How it works

Ready in 3 simple steps

1

Add your clothes

Add a photo of each item, then enter the brand, category and price. Your digital wardrobe is ready in minutes.

2

Ask AI for outfits

Tap "Generate with AI" and get 3 outfit combinations instantly, built from the clothes you actually own.

3

Track, save, repeat

Save your favorite outfits, track laundry, monitor your wardrobe value. Your personal style assistant, every single day.
